## How it works

`calc.js` lines 1 to 3 hold the whole function:

```js
export function add(a, b) {
  return a + b;
}
```

`add` hands both arguments straight to JavaScript's `+` operator. Nothing converts or checks them first. If either value is a string, `+` turns both into strings and joins them. It only adds them as numbers when neither one is a string.
